title: Oncall temporary coverage slab - Nov 2028
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, ad-hoc sheet to triage temporary oncall coverage gaps for the coming two-week window (2028-11-10 to 2028-11-24). Use for quick handoffs, short-term swaps, and to record who is committed for each shift. Not intended to replace the canonical rota in PagerDuty — this is a fast operational artifact for cross-team coordination when spikes or absences appear.

How to use this document (short):
- Owners update their row in the green cells when they accept an assignment.
- If you take a shift, add your name + contact method and set "confirmed".
- If you are a backup, populate the last-checked timestamp and Slack handle.
- Escalation path: SRE on-call -> Platform Eng lead -> Eng SRE manager. See linked artifacts for direct refs.

Summary metrics (snapshot taken 2028-11-09 14:20 PT):
- Total open shifts (48h slots): 6
- Confirmed volunteers: 3
- Needed backups: 4
- Risk level (manual estimate): medium (two overlapping holiday absences)

Coverage table (rows = shifts). Columns: shift-id | service | window | primary | primary-contact | backup | backup-contact | confirmed | notes | handoff-checklist status
1 | API-prod | 2028-11-11 00:00-08:00 PT | Miguel Santos | miguel@redwood.ai (sms) | Leah Chen | @leah (slack) | confirmed | migrating tokens test scheduled; watch KV cache warming | checklist: basic runbook verified
2 | Embeddings-pipeline | 2028-11-12 08:00-16:00 PT | unassigned | n/a | Ravi Patel | ravi@redwood.ai (call) | pending | spike expected from partner pilot; needs dedicated tracer | checklist: create temporary alert channel
3 | Hosted-api-eu | 2028-11-13 16:00-00:00 PT | Jonas Meyer | jonas@redwood.ai | unassigned | n/a | partial | must validate fallback routes if eu-qps>5k | checklist: verify region fallback enabled
4 | Dedicated-gpu-batches | 2028-11-15 00:00-12:00 PT | unassigned | n/a | unassigned | n/a | open | scheduled deploy earlier that morning, likely noisy | checklist: coordinate with release-engineering
5 | Private-vpc-ops | 2028-11-18 12:00-20:00 PT | Leah Chen | leah@redwood.ai | Miguel Santos | miguel@redwood.ai | confirmed | customer sandbox test; monitor network egress | checklist: ensure KMS key access
6 | Streaming-router | 2028-11-20 20:00-04:00 PT | unassigned | n/a | Ravi Patel | ravi@redwood.ai | pending | known lagging metric issue; needs manual cache clear on recurrence | checklist: add temp runbook step for cache flush

Quick action items (owner + ETA):
- Leah: follow up with Eng SRE on runbook additions for Streaming-router (ETA 2028-11-10).
- Miguel: cover Dedicated-gpu-batches if no volunteer by 2028-11-14, mark confirmed.
- Ravi: validate Embeddings-pipeline alert thresholds with Observability (ETA 2028-11-11).

Unresolved questions / edge cases:
- Should we create a dedicated short-lived PagerDuty schedule for the vendor pilot weekend? (pros: single source of truth; cons: time to configure).
- What is the official count method for overlapping holidays that cross PST/CET? Current approach used local window start. Need to confirm with People Ops.

Handoff checklist (short):
- Confirm alert routing is set for the shift window.
- Share runbook link in the Slack shift thread.
- Snapshot top-3 dashboards and attach as message.
- Confirm contact method (sms/call) is reachable and acknowledge.
- If any config change planned, set pre/post deploy watch windows.

Notes on provenance and next steps:
- Created after quick sync 2028-11-07 where product-ops and SRE surfaced 6 short-term gaps due to two engineers on leave.
- This sheet should be archived and summarized into the weekly ops pulse after the window closes (owner: product-ops).
- If gaps persist beyond the two-week window, propose a small rotation change to the oncall schedule and initiate a PagerDuty change request (linked: JIRA-OPS-9842).

Quick links (paste into Slack if needed):
- Canonical rota (PagerDuty): https://pagerduty.com/schedules/redwood-core
- Runbooks folder (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ops/Runbooks
- Post-mortem template: CONFLUENCE-1204

Revision history:
- 2028-11-07 Aisha Karim: created initial slab with 6 open shifts and baseline notes.
- 2028-11-08 Miguel Santos: updated shift 1 confirmed and added contact methods.
- 2028-11-09 Leah Chen: added notes for private-vpc-ops and handoff checklist adjustments.

If you're reading this and taking an action: please update the row you touched and add a timestamp and Slack handle. If you need help assigning someone temporary, ping #oncall-ops and include the shift id.
